gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
